about.title: About me
paragraphs: I'm a Information Systems student at CESMAC and a Full-Stack developer in training. I focus on web application development using technologies like C#, ASP.NET Core, Java, Python, Angular, PostgreSQL and SQLite.
I constantly seek to transform knowledge acquired in my studies into practical projects, also exploring Artificial Intelligence, data and automation.

My goal is to evolve as a developer through building real solutions with Artificial Intelligence and automation, maintaining a routine of continuous learning and experimentation with new technologies.
